emergency_stop.description: Stop irrigation immediately and set the persistent installation safety lock.

set_installation_operation.description: Enable or disable all irrigation operation for one installation.

set_installation_automation.description: Enable or disable automatic irrigation for one installation.

plan_automatic.name: Replan automatic irrigation
plan_automatic.description: Atomically rebuild unstarted automatic irrigation orders from the weekly plans.

correct_physical_meter.name: Correct physical meter
correct_physical_meter.description: Align the physical meter total without changing recorded consumption.

list_card_orders.name: List open irrigation orders
list_card_orders.description: Return the open irrigation orders used by the overview card.

list_zone_history.name: List zone irrigation history
list_zone_history.description: Return one filtered page of completed irrigation executions for a zone.

installation_hardware.title: Optional main valve
installation_hardware.description: Leave this empty when the installation has no shared main valve.

installation_meter.title: Optional water measurement
installation_meter.description: Choose no measurement, a cumulative volume sensor, or a raw pulse counter. Only fields needed by that source are requested next.

installation_meter_details.title: Water meter source
installation_meter_details.description: Select the source sensor. Raw pulse counters additionally require a conversion factor so counts can be converted to liters.

installation_extensions.title: Optional extensions
installation_extensions.description: Every module can later be disabled without deleting its settings or restricting basic irrigation.

installation_zone.title: First irrigation zone
installation_zone.description: Choose the valve that controls this irrigation zone and whether irrigation ends by runtime or measured volume.

data_description.name: A recognizable name for the area irrigated together.
data_description.zone_valve: The valve that opens and closes the complete irrigation zone.
data_description.control_type: Time control ends after a runtime; volume control ends at the measured water target.
data_description.volume_max_runtime: Safety limit in hours, minutes, and seconds if the volume target is not reached.

installation_zone_plant.title: Plant and site profile
installation_zone_plant.description: Choose whether this zone should store profile data and show qualitative recommendations.

installation_subarea.title: Plant, soil, and application
installation_subarea.description: All subareas in this zone are watered simultaneously. Area later enables conversion from millimeters of water depth to liters. The soil profile describes storage and infiltration and must not be applied as a generic evaporation multiplier. Catalog values are broad recommendations. Prefer measured or calibrated values. Different subareas can cause over- or underwatering.

installation_baseline.title: Recommendation and baseline
installation_baseline.description:
{recommendation}

Profile data alone cannot determine exact liters, runtime, or weekly frequency. A manual-only zone may leave the baseline empty; it must be confirmed before adding the first automatic window.

first_zone_seasonal.title: Seasonal adjustment
first_zone_seasonal.description: Seasonal adjustment changes only automatic irrigation orders that have not started.

data.use_seasonal_adjustment: Use seasonal adjustment for this zone

first_zone_seasonal_curve.title: Seasonal monthly curve
first_zone_seasonal_curve.description: 1.00 is neutral. Allowed factors range from 0.10 to 3.00. Values are interpolated daily.

first_zone_seasonal_review.title: Review seasonal targets
first_zone_seasonal_review.description:
Target preview at the monthly anchors:
{preview}

installation_schedule.title: Weekly schedule
installation_schedule.description: Set an irrigation window and target for each required weekday. Leave unused days empty. A window may cross midnight.

physical_meter_correction.description: The correction changes only the aligned physical meter total. Consumption history remains unchanged. The optional reason is stored in the audit history.
